reserves.name: Physical gold bars (LBMA Good Delivery, Swiss vaults)
reserves.issuerOrObligor: London Good Delivery physical gold owned by XAUT token holders

sources.label: BDO Tether Gold Reserves Report - March 31, 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The March 31, 2026 Tether Gold Reserves Report identifies the complete direct reserve as London Good Delivery physical gold vaulted in Switzerland. It reports 707,747.139 fine troy ounces against 707,747.090000 XAUT in circulation and states that each token is backed by at least one fine troy ounce; BDO reconciled the reported liabilities to the relevant blockchain ledgers.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Tether Gold March 31, 2026 reserves report and official transparency feed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete direct reserve asset is identified as physical gold; custodian identity and provider allocation remain unknown and are recorded in the custody profile.

sources.label: BDO Tether Gold Reserves Report - March 31, 2026

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The report states that the gold is vaulted in Switzerland, is owned by XAUT token holders rather than TG Commodities, and gives holders undivided ownership rights to specified bars. It does not name the custodian, disclose provider shares or the custody agreement, prohibit rehypothecation, or provide a legal opinion testing insolvency treatment.
